owner: operator_inbox is a tool with users (Law 6): the codemother dashboard consumes read_ideas/read_intentions; codemother owns the care of the code (ruling 2026-09-06). CC (Fable) builds under Akien's ruling 2026-09-07.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(idea-past-idea) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: an idea the inbox lists open whose date (its stem's leading YYYY-MM-DD) is more than fourteen days old, seen on two consecutive surveys — either it is something that genuinely needs his hand and is sitting, or it moved on through a door the three readers cannot see (the recurrence of this very defect); the probe cannot tell which, so it pokes with the three readers' answers for each stale id and lets the owner tell.
watchme.enough: fourteen consecutive clean surveys (no open idea older than fourteen days) after the crossing; the shim counts pulses, not days, the same stated debt every horizon in this corpus carries.
watchme.carrier: a finding against this ticket's falsifier tooth (3): the stale ids, each with its age in days and the three readers' answers (intent firing named it: none; ticket text cites it: none; acted_on: false), so the receiver can tell 'needs his hand' from 'moved on unseen'.
watchme.consumer: codemother, as owner of the care of the code (ruling 2026-09-06), via the harbor master where its watch reads; Akien sees the poke in the inbox's troubles lane.
